items.headline: Tre Ver Condo Hit By Termite Infestation, Developer UOL Helping Affected Units
items.summary: Residents at Tre Ver condominium are dealing with a termite problem affecting multiple units, with developer UOL stepping in to assist those impacted.
items.meaning: A reminder to condo buyers to ask about pest management history and building upkeep before committing to any purchase.
items.body:
Termites have been found at Tre Ver condominium along Potong Pasir Avenue 1, with multiple units affected. Developer UOL has stepped in to assist residents, though the full scope of damage and the treatment plan are still being worked through.

Termite infestations in concrete buildings are more common than most people expect, especially in developments near mature greenery. The insects can spread through walls and flooring over time, and by the time you spot visible damage, the problem has usually been building for a while.

For anyone buying a resale unit in any condo, this is a clear reminder to ask the seller and the management corporation directly about pest history before you commit. Ask for copies of annual general meeting minutes too, since pest issues and maintenance spending should show up there. If you are specifically looking at Tre Ver, find out which units were affected and confirm what treatment was done and when before you sign anything.
items.headline_zh: Tre Ver Condo爆发白蚁问题，发展商UOL协助受影响住户
items.summary_zh: Tre Ver公寓多个单位受白蚁侵扰，发展商UOL已介入协助受影响住户。
items.meaning_zh: 提醒condo买家，签约前务必向卖方和管理公司了解楼盘的防虫历史及维修保养状况。
items.body_zh:
白蚁出现在Potong Pasir Avenue 1的Tre Ver公寓，多个单位受到波及。发展商UOL已介入协助住户，但具体受损范围和处理方案目前仍在评估当中。

白蚁侵袭钢筋混凝土建筑，其实比很多人以为的更普遍，尤其是靠近成熟绿化地带的楼盘。白蚁会随着时间慢慢蔓延至墙壁和地板，等到出现明显损坏时，问题往往已积累了一段时间。

如果你在考虑买任何condo的转售单位，这件事是一个明显的提醒：签约前一定要直接向卖方和管理公司询问防虫历史。也可以要求查阅历年常年大会的会议记录，因为虫害问题和维修开销通常会在那里有所记载。如果你特别在看Tre Ver的单位，更要弄清楚哪些单位受到波及，确认曾做过什么处理、是何时进行的，再决定是否签约。

items.headline: Tan Boon Liat Building Sold En Bloc For $950M As Seller Expectations Get More Realistic
items.summary: The Tan Boon Liat Building has been acquired in a $950 million collective sale, with analysts noting that sellers are becoming more pragmatic about pricing as deal momentum builds across the market.
items.meaning: If you live in an older development, a fresh wave of en bloc activity means collective sale discussions could resurface, but only if owners price realistically.
items.body:
The Tan Boon Liat Building along Outram Road has been sold collectively for $950 million, one of the larger en bloc deals in recent memory. Analysts say the transaction reflects a shift in how sellers in older developments are thinking about pricing, with more owner groups now willing to accept realistic figures rather than waiting indefinitely for a peak valuation.

En bloc activity went quiet for a stretch because sellers were quoting prices that made it impossible for developers to pencil in a profit, especially with construction costs still high. What appears to have changed is that enough owners have accepted that a reserve price needs to make commercial sense for a buyer before any deal can happen.

If you live in an older development, this deal is a signal that the en bloc cycle has found some momentum again. But whether your building can follow depends on whether a strong enough majority of owners can agree on a reserve price that is realistic, not just aspirational. Many buildings that failed earlier rounds did so because a small group of owners held out for a figure no developer would touch.
items.headline_zh: Tan Boon Liat Building以$950M集体出售，卖家预期趋于务实
items.summary_zh: Tan Boon Liat Building以$950 million集体出售，分析师指出随着市场交投回升，卖家在定价上愈来愈实际。
items.meaning_zh: 如果你住在较旧的楼盘，新一波en bloc活动意味着集体出售讨论可能重启，但前提是屋主愿意以合理的价格出售。
items.body_zh:
Outram Road的Tan Boon Liat Building以$950 million集体出售，是近年来规模较大的en bloc交易之一。分析师表示，这宗交易反映出旧楼屋主在定价思维上的转变，越来越多的屋主群体愿意接受实际的价格，而不是无了期地等待估值的高峰。

En bloc活动之前一度沉寂，原因是卖家开价太高，令发展商难以算出合理的利润空间，加上建筑成本持续高企。如今的改变，在于足够多的屋主接受了一个现实：底价必须让买家在商业上说得通，交易才能成事。

如果你住在较旧的楼盘，这宗交易是一个信号，说明en bloc周期已重新找到动力。但你的楼盘能否跟上，关键在于是否有足够多数的屋主能就一个务实的底价达成共识，而不是单凭期望来定价。许多楼盘之前集体出售失败，正是因为少数屋主坚持要一个没有发展商愿意接受的价格。

items.headline: Singapore Mortgage Rates Are Competitive Again, But The Cheapest Loan Is Not Always The Right One
items.summary: Home loan rates in Singapore have fallen back to attractive levels, but financial experts warn that the headline rate is only one factor since lock-in periods, penalty clauses and loan structure all matter too.
items.meaning: If you are buying or refinancing, now is a good time to shop around, but compare the full package rather than just chasing the lowest advertised rate.
items.body:
Home loan rates in Singapore have fallen back to levels that make borrowing affordable again, and banks are competing actively for business. Buyers who held off because of high rates now have more reasonable options, and existing borrowers who locked in at peak rates have a genuine case to look at refinancing.

The headline rate, however, is only one part of the picture. A loan with a low advertised rate but a three-year lock-in and steep break penalties can cost more over time than a slightly higher rate with more flexibility, particularly if your situation might change before the lock-in ends. Legal fees, valuation costs and cashback promotions all affect the true cost of switching lenders.

The right move is to get full term sheets from at least three lenders and compare the effective cost across the entire lock-in period, not just the rate on the front page. If you are refinancing, calculate whether the savings over the lock-in window actually cover your switching costs before you commit. A broker can help with this, but make sure they are showing you options from banks they do not have exclusive fee arrangements with.
items.headline_zh: 新加坡房贷利率重回吸引水平，但最低利率未必最适合你
items.summary_zh: 新加坡的房贷利率已回落至较具吸引力的水平，但专家提醒，表面利率只是考量因素之一，锁定期、罚款条款和贷款结构同样重要。
items.meaning_zh: 无论是购房还是重新贷款，现在是货比三家的好时机，但要全面比较整体配套，而不只是追求最低的广告利率。
items.body_zh:
新加坡的房贷利率已回落到令借贷再度变得划算的水平，各银行也在积极争取业务。之前因利率高企而观望的买家，现在有了更合理的选择；在高峰期锁定贷款的现有借款人，也有充分理由考虑重新贷款。

不过，表面利率只是整体考量的一部分。广告利率低但锁定期三年、提前还款罚款高的贷款，从长远来看可能比略高利率但更灵活的方案更贵，尤其是当你的情况可能在锁定期结束前发生变化时。律师费、估价费以及现金返还优惠，都会影响转换银行的实际成本。

正确的做法是向至少三家银行索取完整的条款说明书，比较整个锁定期的实际成本，而不只是看第一页的利率。如果你在考虑重新贷款，先计算锁定期内能节省的金额是否足以覆盖转换成本，再做决定。按揭经纪可以协助你，但要确认他们推荐的选项不是只来自有独家收费安排的银行。

items.headline: Dunearn House Sells 55% of Units at Launch, Most Affordable Type Fully Taken Up
items.summary: The first condo in Bukit Timah's new Dunearn estate moved 55% of its units on launch day, with the cheapest unit type selling out completely while larger units saw more measured demand.
items.meaning: Steady but not blockbuster sales suggest buyers are real but selective on price, which is a useful signal if you are weighing this area.
items.body:
Dunearn House, the first condominium in Bukit Timah's newly formed Dunearn estate, sold 55% of its units on launch day. The cheapest unit type was fully taken up, while demand for larger and pricier units was more measured.

That split, entry-level units clearing out while bigger ones move more slowly, is a useful read on buyer mood right now. People are willing to commit, but they are watching their budget carefully. Bukit Timah carries a location premium, and buyers appear to be calculating rather than buying on sentiment.

If you are weighing this development or the broader area, 55% is a solid launch result without being a frenzy. It points to genuine demand rather than speculative buying, which is a healthier sign for the project's long-term value. The fact that not everything sold on day one also means you are not being rushed into a decision, so take the time to do proper due diligence.
items.headline_zh: Dunearn House开盘售出55%单位，最平价户型全数售罄
items.summary_zh: 武吉知马新楼盘Dunearn House在开盘当天售出55%的单位，最便宜的户型全数卖出，较大单位的需求则较为温和。
items.meaning_zh: 销售成绩稳定但不算爆红，显示买家真实但对价格审慎，对于考虑这一带楼盘的你来说，是一个有参考价值的信号。
items.body_zh:
Dunearn House是武吉知马新开辟的Dunearn住宅区第一个condo项目，开盘当天售出55%的单位。最便宜的户型全数售罄，较大、较贵的单位需求则相对温和。

这种分化，入门级单位清盘、较大单位走得较慢，是目前买家心态的一个有用参考。买家愿意出手，但对预算相当谨慎。武吉知马本身有地段溢价，买家看来是经过仔细盘算，而非凭情绪购买。

如果你在考虑这个楼盘或这一带，55%是一个扎实的开盘成绩，但不到抢购的程度。这反映出真实需求，而非投机性买盘，对项目长期价值来说是较健康的信号。而且并非全数在第一天售罄，意味着你不必仓促做决定，可以慢慢做好尽职调查。

items.headline: HDB Resale Prices Fall For Second Straight Quarter, But Million-Dollar Flat Sales Hit Record High
items.summary: Official data shows HDB resale prices dipped 0.3% in Q2 2026, the second consecutive quarterly decline, yet the number of flats sold for $1 million or more hit an all-time high in the same period.
items.meaning: The average HDB price is softening, but premium flats in sought-after locations keep hitting new highs, so the resale market is splitting into two very different stories.
items.body:
HDB resale prices fell 0.3% in the second quarter of 2026, marking the second straight quarterly decline. In the same period, the number of flats sold for $1 million or more hit a record high. Both statements are true at the same time, and that tells you more about the market than either figure does on its own.

What is happening is a split. For most flat types in most estates, prices are softening and buyers have more negotiating room than they did a year ago. But for large, well-located flats in mature estates with good transport or school access, demand is intense and sellers are still finding buyers willing to pay exceptional prices.

If you are a buyer, the headline about falling prices is encouraging in general, but check the actual transaction data for the specific block and street you want before assuming you can bargain hard. If you are a seller, resist the temptation to price based on the million-dollar headlines unless your flat genuinely competes in that bracket. The market is sorting itself clearly by location and quality.
items.headline_zh: HDB转售价连续第二季下跌，但百万元组屋成交量创历史新高
items.summary_zh: 官方数据显示HDB转售价在2026年第二季下跌0.3%，连续第二季录得跌幅，但同期售价达$1 million或以上的组屋数量却创历史新高。
items.meaning_zh: HDB平均价格在走软，但优质地段的高档组屋依然屡创新高，转售市场正分裂成两个截然不同的故事。
items.body_zh:
HDB转售价在2026年第二季下跌0.3%，连续第二个季度录得跌幅。同一时期，售价达到$1 million或以上的组屋数量却创下历史新高。两件事同时为真，放在一起看，比任何单一数字都更能说明市场的实际状况。

正在发生的是一种分化。对于大多数屋型、大多数地区的组屋来说，价格正在走软，买家比一年前拥有更多议价空间。但对于那些位于成熟市镇、交通便利或名校附近的大型优质组屋，需求仍然强劲，卖家依然找得到愿意出高价的买家。

如果你是买家，关于价格下跌的头条新闻大体上令人鼓舞，但在出手前，务必查看你心仪的那栋楼和那条街的实际成交数据，再决定能否大力压价。如果你是卖家，除非你的组屋确实在百万元级别中具竞争力，否则不要参照那些百万成交的头条来定价。市场正按地段和品质清晰地分层。

items.headline: Singapore Private Home Prices Rose 0.5% in Q2, Landed Homes Leading the Gains
items.summary: URA data shows private residential prices edged up 0.5% in Q2 2026, with landed properties the main driver while non-landed homes including condos grew more slowly.
items.meaning: The private market is still moving up, just gradually, so buyers waiting for a sharp price correction may be disappointed.
items.body:
URA data shows private residential prices in Singapore rose 0.5% in the second quarter of 2026. Landed homes including terrace houses, semi-detached properties and bungalows drove most of the gain, while non-landed homes such as condominiums posted slower growth.

Landed properties have stayed firm because the supply of land zoned for that use is genuinely limited in Singapore. That scarcity keeps prices supported even when the broader private market cools. Condominiums face more competition from new launches and a larger pool of available units, which is why that segment is growing more slowly.

For buyers who are waiting for a sharp correction in private home prices before committing, this data does not support that bet. The market is moving gradually but it is still moving upward. A more practical approach is to focus on finding specific projects or locations where you see genuine value, rather than waiting for a broad price reset that the numbers suggest is unlikely.
items.headline_zh: 新加坡私宅价格第二季上涨0.5%，有地房产领涨
items.summary_zh: URA数据显示，2026年第二季私人住宅价格上升0.5%，有地房产是主要涨价动力，包括condo在内的非有地住宅涨幅则较为缓慢。
items.meaning_zh: 私宅市场仍在上涨，只是步伐平稳，等待价格大幅下跌的买家或许会失望而归。
items.body_zh:
URA数据显示，新加坡私人住宅价格在2026年第二季上涨0.5%。有地房产，包括排屋、半独立式房屋和独立洋房，是涨幅的主要来源，而condo等非有地住宅的升幅则较慢。

有地房产价格之所以保持稳固，是因为新加坡可供有地住宅发展的地块确实十分有限。这种稀缺性即使在私宅市场整体放缓时，仍能为价格提供支撑。Condo则面临更多来自新发售项目和市场现有单位的竞争，因此这个市场段的升幅更为缓慢。

对于等待私宅价格大幅回调才愿意出手的买家来说，这份数据并不支持这个策略。市场在缓慢但持续地上升。更务实的做法，是专注寻找你认为有真正价值的特定项目或地段，而不是等待一个数字显示不太可能发生的全面价格重置。

items.headline: Private Home Rents Nudge Up 0.7% in Q2 After an Extended Soft Patch
items.summary: URA data shows private residential rents rose 0.7% in Q2 2026, a modest recovery after an extended period of softening that had given tenants more bargaining power.
items.meaning: For landlords, rents are recovering; for tenants, costs are starting to creep back up after the recent correction, so locking in a longer lease now may save money later.
items.body:
Private home rents in Singapore rose 0.7% in the second quarter of 2026, ending an extended stretch of softening that had put tenants in the stronger position at the negotiating table. The increase is modest, but it marks a clear shift in direction.

Rents had been flat or falling for several quarters as a wave of new completions added supply faster than the market could absorb it. That overhang is now being worked through, and with fewer new completions expected ahead, the balance is tilting back toward landlords.

For tenants whose leases are up for renewal soon, conditions are no longer as favourable as they were six months ago. If you are in a unit you are happy with, locking in a renewal before rents climb further could save you money. For landlords who accepted below-market rates to retain tenants through the soft patch, there is now a reasonable basis to bring rates back to market levels when leases expire.
items.headline_zh: 私宅租金第二季小升0.7%，结束持续一段时间的疲软
items.summary_zh: URA数据显示，2026年第二季私人住宅租金上升0.7%，在经历一段较长的疲软期后出现温和回升，之前的疲软曾让租户拥有较大议价优势。
items.meaning_zh: 对房东而言，租金正在回升；对租户而言，经历近期调整后租金成本开始重新攀升，现在锁定较长租约或许可以省下一笔开支。
items.body_zh:
新加坡私人住宅租金在2026年第二季上升0.7%，终结了一段持续较长、令租户在谈判桌上占据优势的疲软期。涨幅虽然温和，但方向已清晰转变。

此前连续数个季度租金持平或下跌，原因是大批新落成项目短期内增加了大量供应，市场一时难以消化。这一积压情况如今逐渐消退，加上预期往后新落成项目减少，供需天平正在重新向房东倾斜。

对于租约即将到期的租户来说，目前的条件已不如六个月前那般有利。如果你对现住的单位满意，趁租金进一步上涨前锁定续约，或许能为你省下一笔钱。对于在疲软期以低于市价的租金来留住租户的房东来说，当租约到期时，将租金调回市价水平，现在已有合理的依据。

items.headline: Singapore Condo Prices Had Their Slowest First Half Since 2020
items.summary: Non-landed private home prices grew at their slowest pace in the first six months of 2026 compared with any year since the pandemic lows of 2020, signalling a market that has meaningfully cooled off.
items.meaning: For condo buyers, slower price growth means less pressure to rush, giving you more time to be choosy without worrying that prices will run away from you.
items.body:
Non-landed private home prices in Singapore grew at their slowest pace in the first half of 2026 compared with any year since the pandemic lows of 2020. Condo prices have not gone into reverse, but the rate of growth has come down sharply from the pace seen during the peak years of 2021 and 2022.

Several things have combined to produce this slowdown: higher borrowing costs over the past few years, cooling measures that added stamp duty obligations for certain buyers, and a meaningful increase in new unit supply coming to market. Developers have also priced new launches more carefully after seeing what happens when projects are pushed too aggressively.

For condo buyers, this is the most comfortable buying environment in years. Prices are not collapsing, but they are also not sprinting away from you the way they were during the peak. That gives you the time to compare projects properly, push back on pricing, and make a considered decision without the pressure that drove some regrettable purchases when the market was running hot.
items.headline_zh: 新加坡condo价格上半年涨幅为2020年以来最慢
items.summary_zh: 2026年上半年，非有地私宅价格的升幅是自2020年疫情低谷以来同期最慢的，显示市场已明显降温。
items.meaning_zh: 对于condo买家来说，价格涨幅放缓意味着不必急于出手，你有更多时间慢慢挑选，不用担心价格突然大涨。
items.body_zh:
新加坡非有地私宅价格在2026年上半年的升幅，是自2020年疫情低谷以来同期最慢的。Condo价格并没有逆转，但升幅已从2021年和2022年高峰期的步伐大幅放缓。

多项因素合力造成这次降温：过去数年间较高的借贷成本、ABSD等降温措施为特定买家增加了成本，以及市场上新单位供应量的明显增加。发展商在见识过激进定价策略的后果后，在新盘定价上也更加审慎。

对于condo买家来说，这是多年来最舒适的购买环境。价格没有崩盘，但也没有像高峰期那样疾速攀升。这让你有时间好好比较不同项目，与发展商争取更好的价格，做出经过深思熟虑的决定，而不是在市场火热时被迫仓促出手，事后懊悔。
